Aiwen:Well, I usually go for a walk instead.What about you?
Lucas:I just yell and cry!

Close Reading · Task A

Alice:Yafei, what's wrong?You look angry.
Yafei:I am angry!Did you see that boy from another class?He kept making fun of me.He made me look bad!
Alice:That's not nice!
Yafei:I really wanted to shout bad words at him!
Alice:Yafei, you can do better than that!Did you try taking a deep breath?
Yafei:I did, but it's not working.
Alice:OK.Let's try counting to ten.We can do it together.One, two, three ...
Yafei:All right ...One, two, three ...
Alice:Go on.You are doing great!
Yafei:... ten.I feel better now.Thanks, Alice.
Alice:No problem!Come on, let's go for a walk.

Unit 4

Cat or Dog?

Get Started · Task A

Cats:play during the night
Cats:stay inside
Cats:sleep during the day
Dogs:go for a walk
Dogs:don't like to be alone
Cats and dogs:lose hair
Cats and dogs:love playing with toys

Get Started · Task C

Yiming:Nikki, what's it like to have a cat?
Nikki:My cat follows me everywhere.
Yiming:Really?I thought cats liked to be alone.I also heard cats sleep during the day and play at night.
Nikki:Well, my cat does sleep a lot during the day.But she wakes up to play with me when I get home from school.
Yiming:Does she eat a lot?
Nikki:Not very much.

Close Reading · Task A

First, you need to think about space.Cats stay inside most of the time.However, dogs need to go for a walk at least twice a day.They love going to parks!
Next, dogs and cats have different habits.Most cats like to sleep during the day and play during the night.If you are a light sleeper, think twice before getting a cat.
You need to clean dogs often.Unlike dogs, cats usually clean themselves.They both love playing with toys.They both lose hair, too.
Finally, make sure your family is OK with the idea, too!Get an animal everyone will like!

Unit 5

Shop Smart

Get Started · Task A

think about it more
wait a few days
learn about it
look for a better deal
give it a try
compare and choose
Toys
Dolls

Get Started · Task C

Nikki:Yafei, my aunt just gave me 300 yuan to get myself a gift!
Yafei:Wow!What do you plan to get?
Nikki:I'm 12 now.I want to buy a bike.
Yafei:Hold your horses!Do you really need it?
Nikki:What do you mean?
Yafei:Well, you may want to buy something, but it doesn't mean you really need it.
Nikki:So, what should I do?
Yafei:Maybe you can try it out first and think about it more.

Close Reading · Task A

First, think about it: Do I need that thing or do I just want it?If you're not sure, wait a few days.Then, make a decision.
Next, ask yourself: Do I need that thing right now?If not, you can buy it later.Keep an eye out for sales, or try second-hand shops.
After you make up your mind, try to learn more about it.Go online, ask others about it, or give it a try.
Finally, compare and choose.Ask yourself: Is it the best deal?But be careful!Sometimes "buy one get one free" may not be the better deal.Check the "best before date" or BBD for short.

Get Started · Task C

Mulan:Food waste is a big problem at our school.
Sam:Yes.Sometimes the canteen staff give too much food to students.
Mulan:Also, some students are picky about food.
Sam:I know.Do you know what happens to our leftovers?
Mulan:The staff usually throw it away at the end of the day.
Sam:We've got to do something about this!

Close Reading · Task A

There are thirty students in our class.Seven said that they usually don't have enough time for breakfast.So, they feel hungry at noon, and they end up taking too much food.
Three students said that sometimes the canteen staff give them too much food.
Ten students said that they don't like some of the food.So, they don't eat it.
Six students said that they want to chat or play during lunch break.They usually eat very little and then rush out to meet their friends.
Lastly, four students said they like to bring snacks to school.When it is time for lunch, they don't feel hungry at all.

Close Reading · Task A

To: luiskk@mail.com
Subject: What a bad day!
Dear Luis,
I had a bad day yesterday.In the morning, I had an important football game, but I overslept!I ran out of the house without having breakfast.When I arrived at school, I had no time to warm up.I even wore the wrong shoes!What's worse, it was raining!
I am sure you can guess what happened next.I didn't watch out for others on the playground, got pushed, and fell ...And I hurt my right foot again!
My foot is okay.Yafei's mum was there.She is a doctor.But we lost the game.
I did learn a lesson yesterday: Always get ready before sports, and be careful when you play.
Yours,
Lucas

Review

A Gift for Grandpa

Review · Task A

Alice:Hey, guys, what do you think is a good gift?I want to get my grandpa something for his birthday.
Friend 1:Well, first of all, I think it needs to carry meaning.It doesn't have to be big or cost a lot.
Friend 2:I can't agree with you more!Maybe get him something that shows your love.Or something to help him stay healthy.You can also get him something he really needs.
Friend 3:I agree.You want to show your care for him and make his life better.This way, he knows you are always thinking of him.
